svg.title: Retrieve luggage and leave
svg.desc: Cocoon Cabin English portfolio. 2560 x 1440 SVG with an embedded 3840 x 2160 background and editable Inter text.

text.tspan: Stop and return luggage before opening the exit. After a preset exit wait, the cabin resets and the vehicle departs.
See the arrival message and get ready.
Stand up and prepare to collect luggage.
Move the seat aside and return
Luggage returns to the exit side first
Leave with luggage once the exit opens.
to connect the cabin to the street.
READY: luggage returned to exit side
Close the door, restore the seat
Team UI, Quest recording and Unity logic. The prototype uses a timed exit wait; passenger-exit detection is not the reset condition.
